envelope.batchId: safe sortable identifier matching the file name

item.requestId: lowercase UUID emitted once by WPF and reused as Idempotency-Key
item.requestHash: lowercase SHA-256 of the exact fingerprint
item.bodyJson: exact UTF-8 JSON object string used as the HTTP body

hashDomains.envelopeRequestHash: requestHash authenticates the inbox protocol/backend/kind/retryJobId/bodyJson fingerprint and is validated while parsing the committed envelope
hashDomains.apiClientRequestHash: Jobs clientRequestHash is SHA-256 over the fixed method/path scope and the recursively key-sorted parsed body after removing clientRequestId, exactly as the create or retry API computes it

publication.temporaryFile: same pending directory, create-new, write-through, flush-to-disk
publication.commit: same-directory move without overwrite and with write-through
publication.capacity: under the shared Jobs writer lock, bound pending plus processing before source pin or provisional overlay: at most 128 committed envelopes, 256 total directory entries including the new temporary file, and 67108864 actual committed UTF-8 bytes including the new envelope; refusal publishes nothing and does not remove existing files
publication.capacityCoordination: every publisher uses the stable jobs.json shared-directory-lock/v1 target for capacity check through atomic publication; current consumers use that same lock for pending-to-processing claim, receipt cleanup unlink, and needs-action move; source leases close before writer-lock release, and dispatch or network waits never hold this lock
publication.unverifiableEntry: if an enumerated entry's current attributes cannot be verified, refuse publication before source pin or overlay; do not count a failed metadata lookup as an absent file
publication.existingOverflow: ordinary intake retains its fail-closed scan bounds; capacity refusal does not repair an existing over-bound inbox, move unresolved entries out of dependency visibility, delete temporary files by age, or authorize queue resume

consumer.order: createdAt, then publish mtime, then file name
consumer.activeScan: each explicit poll bounds pending plus processing to 256 total directory entries, 128 committed envelopes, and 67108864 total UTF-8 bytes; every candidate is a stable opened plain file whose device and inode still match its path
consumer.activeFilesystemBoundary: enqueue-inbox and v1 plus each active phase directory must be canonical plain directories rather than symlinks, junctions, or reparse redirects; identity drift or a scan-bound breach fails closed without dispatch or Jobs mutation
consumer.oversizedEnvelope: claim then move to needs-action without reading more than maximumEnvelopeUtf8Bytes plus one byte and without dispatch
consumer.namespaceInterlock: claim, matching-receipt cleanup, and definitive-rejection moves acquire the same jobs.json writer lock as publishers, including when SQLite is active; revalidate path and file identity inside each mutation; a stopped lifecycle cannot claim after waiting for the lock; no dispatch occurs while holding this namespace lock
consumer.dispatch: fixed route with exact bodyJson and Idempotency-Key=requestId
consumer.dispatchOwnership: one unfinished route invocation per normalized Inbox root within the owning process; timeout or stop requests abort but does not release ownership until the actual promise settles; consumer replacement and a new interrupted-recovery attempt cannot bypass retained ownership
consumer.responseReuse: reuse a completed response only for the same requestId and envelope requestHash; unfinished processing remains retryable and cannot be classified as definitive rejection or completed intake even if its envelope disappears
consumer.passiveBackoff: passive intake may omit scan, claim and dispatch until the first unresolved candidate's existing retry deadline; explicit intake still validates a fresh snapshot and honors per-candidate retry; no cached snapshot authorizes dispatch and a stopped lifecycle cannot restore the suppression deadline
consumer.success: matching receipt for the same requestId and jobId
consumer.failedRetrySourceDismissal: after a matching retry receipt, attempt idempotent cleanup of the original failed or canceled history row before deleting the envelope; unresolved output-publication evidence keeps that row and its dependencies protected while the accepted retry remains a separate attempt; this protected retention does not invalidate the matching retry receipt; validation rejection, conflict, pending delivery, ambiguous transport, malformed receipt, or writer failure also preserves the source history row
consumer.definitive4xx: move the envelope to needs-action after processing later valid items
consumer.delete: only after every item has a matching durable receipt

maintenanceGate.admission: under the shared Jobs writer lock, normal publication and namespace mutation require the maintenance marker to be absent; an existing file or directory, unreadable path, malformed content, or unknown version fails closed before source pin, overlay, claim or removal
maintenanceGate.queue: normal intake, interrupted recovery, queue resume and new worker claims cannot bypass the marker; already admitted work may finish its own durable receipt and terminal writes
maintenanceGate.reads: ordinary viewing, health and Jobs reads remain passive; source-dependency reads refuse to authorize destructive operations while maintenance is present or unverifiable
maintenanceGate.lifetime: normal startup, timeout, PID absence and marker age never remove this gate; a saved phase does not prove that maintenance owns execution after restart
maintenanceGate.execution: this gate alone does not authorize maintenance execution; an explicit repair must separately establish exclusive ownership, validate a bounded fixed inventory and preserve resumable progress
maintenanceGate.activityLease: long Companion route dispatch, interrupted recovery and worker execution hold a Windows reader lease at the actual canonical Enhancement root's enqueue-inbox/activity.lock before checking marker absence under the Jobs lock; the reader lasts until actual operation settlement, including terminal writes, rather than timeout, abort or client disconnect
maintenanceGate.shortWriters: WPF publication and short Inbox namespace changes keep the existing Jobs lock plus marker check; they do not acquire a second activity reader or depend on the global locator lease
maintenanceGate.quiescenceLimit: an exclusive activity lease proves exclusion only of cooperating operations in this protocol; it does not prove that older unregistered writers or externally detached child work have stopped, and cannot alone authorize a maintenance session on an unsupported owner cohort
maintenanceGate.workerStop: a maintenance admission refusal ends the worker without failure backoff or automatic queue resume; unreadable admission state remains closed

maintenanceOwnerCohort.scope: a finite managed launch configuration for the same canonical Enhancement root and Jobs/Inbox binding; this is a cooperative product deployment contract, not proof against arbitrary same-user programs
maintenanceOwnerCohort.enrollment: an existing verified update/startup mechanism must bind a completed enrollment intent to the root identity, supported artifact manifest digest, participation protocol, managed launch generation and external-work lifetime profile; a request boolean, self-reported version or record checksum is insufficient
maintenanceOwnerCohort.legacyCutover: before enrolling a legacy root, establish positive evidence that the prior execution generation ended and cannot restart through managed launch paths; retain Jobs, receipts, envelopes, temporary files, source references and media without copying to a different root or changing request identities
maintenanceOwnerCohort.externalWork: every child or delegated execution path able to mutate the maintenance resources or their actual acceptance dependencies must remain protected until its interfering side effects end, including late publication, callbacks, cleanup and parent process death; a released parent handle, settled promise or absent PID is not sufficient
maintenanceOwnerCohort.maintenanceResources: the actual root and Jobs/Inbox binding; marker, lease, fixed inventory, plan, progress and archive; Inbox namespaces; Jobs, receipts, request identity, retry source state and ordering; and every source, producer reference, file identity or namespace actually read or changed by the existing create/retry acceptance handlers
maintenanceOwnerCohort.noninterferingExternalWork: an existing lifetime profile may exclude an external execution path only after the supported managed artifacts establish that its write, rename, delete and cleanup effects cannot reach maintenance resources or acceptance dependencies through aliases or parent moves; no late completion or parent-death path may return there without the existing ownership gate, and maintenance must not adopt or depend on that path's unverified output; process presence alone does not require shutdown, model unload or an unrelated execution-generation change
maintenanceOwnerCohort.existingParticipants: dispatch, recovery and worker paths already holding an activity reader retain it through actual settlement and terminal writes; exclusion of independent noninterfering external work does not shorten a reader lifetime or bypass the root exclusive
maintenanceOwnerCohort.invalidation: root replacement, incompatible artifact or managed startup changes, unsupported rollback, or known unresolved external execution invalidate enrollment; merely retaining an inactive old artifact does not
maintenanceOwnerCohort.execution: valid enrollment is an applicability condition only; each repair separately acquires the live root exclusive and validates its own operation and plan; a deployment without a verified enrollment provider must leave repair entry disabled

maintenanceEnrollmentHandoff.entry: explicit desktop launcher EnrollmentEnhancementRoot option, before ordinary activation and under the same startup mutex; no rebuild, activation fallback, alternate instance identity or automatic Companion start
maintenanceEnrollmentHandoff.observation: the probe pins the supported eight-file artifact set and matches the manifest digest returned by the launch freshness check; a bounded cold child holds the ordinary per-user instance mutex without publishing an activation event, independently resolves the actual process-fixed Jobs path and observes the existing canonical root handle identity and artifact digest; parent binds its private pipe reply to nonce, attempt, managed handoff generation, actual child PID and process start time
maintenanceEnrollmentHandoff.generation: the new launch generation identifies this handoff attempt only; it is not evidence that a historical execution generation ended or that old external work cannot publish
maintenanceEnrollmentHandoff.outcomes: probe exit 2 means handoff rejected; exit 10 means handoff verified with enrollment evidence unavailable; both JSON replies report enrolled=false and maintenanceAllowed=false; earlier launcher refusal returns 2 with a diagnostic on stderr; no enrollment-committed outcome is implemented
maintenanceEnrollmentHandoff.limits: 16 KiB per pipe packet, 10-second packet read deadline, 15-second child exit deadline and 45-second outer probe deadline; only task-created probe processes may be terminated on timeout
maintenanceEnrollmentHandoff.authority: a verified handoff creates no enrollment record and enables no repair route; independent legacy-cutover and external-work lifetime evidence required by maintenanceOwnerCohort remains mandatory, including when the new WPF matches but an old child can still mutate acceptance dependencies
maintenanceEnrollmentHandoff.persistence: read-only observation of existing artifacts and process-fixed paths, with normal TEMP coordination only; no Jobs, Inbox, enrollment intent, plan, locator, media, worker, recovery, drain or maintenance begin/run mutation

maintenanceControl.transport: existing authenticated and encrypted Companion tunnel only; the plaintext path is not an alternate entry
maintenanceControl.availability: disabled unless the deployment supplies the verified owner-enrollment provider required by maintenanceOwnerCohort; request data cannot enable it
maintenanceControl.request: a strict JSON object containing action (begin or run) and a caller-chosen lowercase UUID operationId; at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes; duplicate keys, invalid action or invalid identity are rejected before ownership acquisition
maintenanceControl.begin: persist the caller identity before replying; a same-operation replay returns its current phase without rewriting progress, while another active operation refuses admission; a completed replay validates its root-bound receipt and immutable plan and cannot start a new repair or consume later arrivals
maintenanceControl.run: revalidate enrollment and reacquire live root exclusion on every execution; continue only the matching durable operation; waiting or draining is not completion
maintenanceControl.responses: 202 with operationId and phase for an incomplete operation; 200 with phase complete only for validated completion; authenticated failures stay inside the encrypted response; unavailable deployments return 404
maintenanceControl.responseLoss: retain the original operationId across retries; client disconnect does not release execution ownership before actual settlement; replaying begin recovers the phase after a lost start or completion response
maintenanceControl.queue: neither request performs ordinary recovery, inbox wake, worker wake or automatic queue resume; repair replay retains the existing fixed-inventory and paused-queue rules

maintenanceInventory.scope: a separate explicit repair only; ordinary publication, intake and dependency-read bounds remain unchanged
maintenanceInventory.discovery: fully validate pending plus processing before the first replay, using the normal strict envelope parser and stable plain-file identity and SHA-256 checks; unknown entries, conflicting request identities, duplicate batch filenames, malformed or unsupported envelopes, path redirects and bounds refuse the fixed inventory without moving originals
maintenanceInventory.order: createdAt, then original publish mtime, then filename; freeze this complete order and the exact file identity, hash and item count in an immutable operation-bound plan
maintenanceInventory.uncommitted: count and retain plain .tmp entries; record their identities without promoting or deleting them
maintenanceInventory.resume: reacquire live exclusive ownership, revalidate the operation, plan hash, root and fixed inventory, and resume durable progress; loss after a Job commit but before cursor persistence replays the same requestId, body and API idempotency hash
maintenanceInventory.progress: atomic flushed state with operation and root binding; reject inconsistent progress and preserve compatible additive fields; a progress checksum detects corruption but is not owner authorization
maintenanceInventory.dispatch: invoke only the existing create/retry handlers outside the Jobs lock, while retaining the exclusive activity lease through actual completion; operation/root/plan-bound internal replay does not reenter normal reader admission; never grant this exception from a request flag or saved plan alone; suppress every queue wake and keep the durable queue paused
maintenanceInventory.originals: retain all original active envelopes until every planned item has a matching receipt or definitive non-retryable 4xx; preserve successful originals in an operation archive, and keep definitive failures in the normal needs-action namespace using its existing filename contract; never overwrite a collision
maintenanceInventory.completion: recheck current durable acceptance for every accepted item, including accepted items in envelopes that also contain definitive failures, before moving its original; preserve unchanged uncommitted files and refuse completion if any unplanned active entry remains; persist an operation-bound completion receipt before removing the marker under the Jobs lock; never resume the queue automatically
maintenanceInventory.entryRequirement: the authenticated repair entry must independently establish a supported owner cohort; the inventory, saved phase, PID absence, lease alone or a request boolean cannot grant this authority

managedVideoSourceReservation.scope: video create items may reserve sourceProducerJobId or sourceManagedOutputPath; Video Tools create items reserve sourceVideoJobId; retry items resolve the referenced durable source job
managedVideoSourceReservation.wpfPublicationOverlay: after the final source validator, WPF acquires the shared Jobs writer lock, opens and identity-checks the exact source with delete sharing denied for video create, saved-Prompt video rerun, Video Tools create, and video retry publication, records each create requestId and managed source or sourceVideoJobId in its UI overlay, atomically publishes pending state, and only then closes the source handle and releases the writer lock; a create overlay remains until the enqueue call returns, and a successful saved-delivery or job response first transfers protection to durable inbox or active Jobs state; every video retry source in an envelope is pinned before that envelope is published
managedVideoSourceReservation.authoritativeDeleteGuard: managed image-output DELETE and managed video-output DELETE hold the active Jobs-store write lock, read the latest Jobs and idempotency state, then passively scan committed inbox state before deleting the canonical file or committing deleted status
managedVideoSourceReservation.pendingAndProcessing: a video item without a visible job or durable terminal receipt protects its named producer output, displayed managed path, or sourceVideoJobId producer output; unresolved video retries protect the source used by the referenced durable video job
managedVideoSourceReservation.needsAction: after a complete valid envelope scan, an item without a visible job or durable terminal receipt is the definitive 4xx no-job outcome and no longer reserves a source; items with an outcome defer to latest Jobs state
managedVideoSourceReservation.idempotencyResolution: requestId and the independently recomputed API clientRequestHash must match Jobs; envelope requestHash is separately validated by the inbox parser and is never compared with Jobs clientRequestHash; a receipt is terminal, while a visible job is accepted only with a known status and supported operation, and an active visible video source is checked directly; conflict, future, malformed, or unsupported state fails closed
managedVideoSourceReservation.retryOutcomeResolution: a visible retry outcome with matching requestId and API clientRequestHash remains authoritative after the normal matching-receipt cleanup dismisses its failed or canceled source row; when that source row still exists its operation is additionally cross-checked, while an unresolved pending or processing retry still requires the source row
managedVideoSourceReservation.malformedFutureOrOverBound: fail closed without deleting the managed output or rewriting Jobs state
managedVideoSourceReservation.passiveRead: does not create directories, claim or move envelopes, dispatch requests, wake or start a worker, retry delivery, or mutate inbox state
managedVideoSourceReservation.committedFiles: inspect safe plain .json files only; ignore uncommitted .tmp files; pending and processing filenames must match batchId, while collision-suffixed needs-action filenames retain the validated embedded batchId
managedVideoSourceReservation.publicationTransfer: video create, saved-Prompt rerun, or Video Tools create: shared Jobs writer lock -> exact source handle without delete sharing -> in-process overlay -> atomic pending publish -> source handle close -> writer lock release; video retry: shared Jobs writer lock -> validate and pin every video source in the envelope without delete sharing -> atomic pending publish -> source handles close -> writer lock release; if DELETE wins the writer lock first it completes before the publisher's final source pin, and if publication wins first DELETE must rescan the committed pending state after acquiring that lock
managedVideoSourceReservation.writerInterlock: every WPF publication, Companion Inbox namespace mutation, and Companion Jobs mutation uses the same recoverable shared-directory-lock/v1 target at the Enhancement root's jobs.json pathname, including when SQLite is the active Jobs backend
managedVideoSourceReservation.lockOrder: both paths acquire the shared Jobs writer lock first; DELETE reads latest Jobs, passively scans inbox, verifies dependencies, deletes, and writes while holding it; publication then pins source files and publishes pending state while holding it; source handles close before writer-lock release, and wake/network/dispatch happen after release

jobsStoreIdempotency.payloadRestriction: receipt entries contain no source path, prompt, or request body
jobsStoreIdempotency.atomicity: job transition and receipt creation share one active-store transaction; legacy JSON uses its existing lock and atomic replacement
jobsStoreIdempotency.matchingReplay: return a receipt-only 2xx with the original jobId when the visible job no longer exists
jobsStoreIdempotency.conflictingReplay: return 409 when the same clientRequestId has a different clientRequestHash
jobsStoreIdempotency.capacity: when a new receipt is required at capacity, reject terminal history dismissal with 409 and retain the visible job
jobsStoreIdempotency.compatibility: legacy version-1 stores without the field remain valid
jobsStoreIdempotency.preservation: unknown root and receipt fields round-trip unchanged
jobsStoreIdempotency.integrity: malformed, duplicate, or conflicting receipt state fails closed without replacing or committing the active Jobs store

compatibility.legacyDirectPost: never used by this v1 WPF writer
compatibility.unknownOrLegacyProbe: publish locally and send no POST
compatibility.immediateNudge: allowed only for the exact ready v1 capability; after publication the authenticated bodyless queue-recovery route recovers an interrupted running row before draining the inbox and returns the matching receipt when the request id is present
compatibility.rollback: restore the prior WPF and companion together; retain published envelopes
